Verify that an Invoice does not progress beyond the approval stage when all configured approvers are inactive or disabled.
Verify that an Invoice cannot be auto-approved when the only approver is the Invoice submitter.
Verify that an Invoice is not auto-skipped from the Review stage when the assigned reviewer does not have Invoice module access.
Verify that an Invoice is blocked at a workflow stage when the middle stage of a multi-stage workflow has no eligible approver.
Verify that cancelling an Invoice after matching it with a GRN changes the GRN status back to Unmatched and releases the matched quantity.
Verify that partial quantity matching works correctly when multiple Invoices are matched against the available GRN and PO quantity.
Verify that an Invoice cannot be Accounted without a valid GRN match when GRN matching is mandatory.
Verify that a GRN cannot be cancelled after it has been matched with an active Invoice, or that the configured cascade handling is performed correctly.
Verify that duplicate Invoice reference numbers are validated when an existing Invoice is edited and submitted.
Verify that the subject character limit is validated when an Invoice is edited and submitted with more than 240 characters.
Verify that an Invoice cannot exceed the remaining PO balance when multiple Invoices are created against the same PO.
Verify that the same Invoice reference number can be used across different entities when duplicate validation is scoped at the entity level.
Verify that rejecting an Invoice at the approval stage updates its status consistently across the detail page, listing page, and reports.
Verify that rejecting or sending back an Invoice at the Review stage updates its status correctly across all applicable pages and reports.
Verify that rejecting a transaction at the Acknowledge stage updates the transaction and parent status correctly.
Verify that cancelling a transaction removes it from the approver's My Pending Approvals list.
Verify that cancelling a transaction at any workflow stage removes it from all approvers' pending approval lists.

Verify that every mandatory field configured in the Supplier Onboarding template triggers validation when left blank.
Verify that users with configured Supplier Edit access can edit the details of an onboarded supplier.
Verify that the Supplier status changes to Sync Failed when supplier integration fails after onboarding and approval.
Verify that the Supplier status changes to Registered only after successful integration following onboarding and approval.
Verify that a supplier can be blocked and unblocked successfully across all configured entities.
Verify that duplicate Invoice reference validation works when a Supplier Portal Invoice is edited with an existing reference number.
Verify that duplicate Invoice reference validation works across supplier-created and buyer-created Invoices.
